notes: Only the first of the four coordinated infinitival lə's carries an English word (the that of and that thou wouldest walk); the rest are unrepresented under rules 52 and 40.
In lihyôṯ lᵉkā lēʾlōhîm the infinitive holds to be, so the lə of lᵉkā keeps nothing and its suffix takes thy, and the resultative lē before ʾĕlōhîm is unrepresented as well (rules 21, 40).
